Hi everyone. I've posted the slides from Mr. Marshall's
presentation this morning in the documents section of this
discussion group.

So, what are your reactions? What are your favorite ideas?
Do you plan to try anything?

| don't know. My employees work in three different time
zones.

I'm going to schedule a monthly lunch with my team.

| agree with Fiona. | know that creating personal connections
can increase morale and productivity, but | don't think
Mr. Marshall's suggestions were practical for all of us.

What about teleconferencing or setting up an online meeting?

| have a lot of new hires. | think I'll try some of the
get-to-know-you games in my next couple of meetings.

It's not quite the same, but that's a thought. At least it
costs less.

Do you have a budget for travel, even once a year?
Yes, that would be an inexpensive way to go.

There's a chapter about the challenges of long-distance team
building in the book Mr. Marshall referenced in the talk.

Is there? | found out that our company library has a copy.
| should check it out.

Maybe we can provide a link so everyone can find it!

I'll also see if there's a digital version. Thanks, everyone. Feel
free to continue to use this space to share your ideas, and |
hope you can join us in two weeks for the next talk, "Pros and
Cons of Flexible Scheduling."

David, let us know how your games go. Maybe some of them
